**DISCLAIMER**

Apache OpenServerless is an effort undergoing incubation at The Apache Software Foundation (ASF), sponsored by the Apache Incubator. Incubation is required of all newly accepted projects until a further review indicates that the infrastructure, communications, and decision making process have stabilized in a manner consistent with other successful ASF projects. While incubation status is not necessarily a reflection of the completeness or stability of the code, it does indicate that the project has yet to be fully endorsed by the ASF.

**THESE IMAGES ARE NOT APACHE RELEASES**

The container images published in this repository are convenience artifacts built from unreleased source code. They are **not** official Apache OpenServerless (incubating) releases: they have not been voted on by the Apache OpenServerless PPMC nor approved by the Apache Incubator PMC, and they may contain code whose licensing has not been reviewed.

Apache OpenServerless (incubating) has no approved release yet. When source releases become available they will be published at https://downloads.apache.org/incubator/openserverless/ — the source release is the only official Apache artifact.

Use these images at your own risk, for development and evaluation only.
